question: The detection of the end point of a chloride assessment by the Volhard method occurs:

options.opa: When a red silver chromate precipitate appears.
options.opb: When a complex of Fe + 3 thiocyanate appears red.
options.opc: When the silver chloride precipitate adsorbs a cationic indicator and the solution changes color.
options.opd: When the silver chloride precipitate adsorbs an anionic indicator and the solution changes color.
